t: You're on Vere Street, just off Oxford Street in Marylebone. It continues Welbeck Street, and takes its name from the Earls of Oxford, whose family name was Vere and who owned the area when it was built. The street is best known for the Marybone Chapel, now St Peter's Vere Street. The sculptor John Michael Rysbrack lived here and died here in 1770. John Bailey, a British ethnographer who served as Assistant Colonial Secretary of Ceylon, also died here, in 1867.
